substeps.caption: The sash rises to its stop, 457 mm (18 in) open. The arm works through that opening, as a person does.
Air sweeps in under the sash, over the airfoil, through the baffle's slots and up the 325 mm collar to the building's exhaust.
A polished Al coupon goes into Weck's reagent (KMnO4 and NaOH in water) for a few seconds: an HF-free tint etch for Al alloys.
Then into the rinse water, while the hood keeps pulling.
Sash down. Nothing here uses HF: ICP-MS goes out to the BYU Spectroscopic Facility's Agilent 8900. 1219 mm wide, 2.4 m tall with its base: it stands on the floor.
